Plans and Pricing

Netflix offers a variety of plans to meet your entertainment needs. In Canada, plans cost:

  • Standard with ads: $7.99 / month
  • Standard: $19.99 / month
  • Premium: $23.99 / month

Extra members

Add an extra member with ads for $5.99 / month, or an extra member for $7.99 / month.

Prices don’t include sales tax.
